title: Riot Squad BAR EDTN Limited Edition Pink Razz Citrus 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Pink Razz Citrus from Riot Squad’s Bar Edition Limited Edition series delivers a zingy blend of tangy-sweet Pink Raspberry and sharp, zesty Citrus. The Raspberry lends a bold, jammy sweetness, while the Citrus note cuts through with a sparkling brightness that adds clarity and complexity to the mix. Mint infused With its smooth nicotine salt formulation and fast-absorbing delivery, this e-liquid offers a tactile yet comfortable throat hit ideal for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping. It’s available in 5mg, 10mg and 20mg strengths, and performs best in low-powered pod systems, vape pens, and refillable starter kits. Riot’s Bar Edition Nic Salt range replicates the punchy, layered taste of popular disposable vape flavours in a more sustainable format. Pink Razz Citrus stands out for its sweet-tart sharpness and vibrant fruit pairing—ideal for vapers who prefer bold, juicy flavour with a twist.
